title: Silk stroke vs fab minimums
hypothesis: Raising every silkscreen stroke (own text/lines and footprint silk) from 0.12 to 0.15 mm, keeping text height 0.8 mm, makes the silk meet PCBWay/Elecrow/Seeed Fusion minimums (and JLCPCB high-precision) without changing copper, drill or mask
expected: F.Silk/B.Silk gerber stroke min >= 0.15 mm; copper, mask, edge, drill gerbers byte-identical apart from timestamps; DRC 0; check_board OK with pad/silk margin 0.15 mm
method: gen_pcb.py silk width constant + footprint silk width override; make_board --reuse-routes; make_fabrication; compare file hashes with the 4973aba gerbers; verify_gerbers; gerbonara stroke histogram
fail: copper/drill differ, DRC != 0, labels no longer fit (J1/J2 band) => try JEDGE/row gaps; else REVERT and document JLCPCB high-precision option instead

observation: silk strokes 0.12 -> 0.15 mm (all silk incl. footprint outlines), J1/J2 label rows re-fitted (header gap 0.08, row gap 0.16, XIAO outline gap >= 0.15); copper/mask/paste/outline/drill gerbers identical in geometry; DRC 0; check_board OK at 0.15 mm margin; fab check PASS for PCBWay/Elecrow/Seeed Fusion

title: Candidate: 44x29 mm + 1.0 mm text for JLCPCB-standard silk
hypothesis: A 1 mm board-height increase lets all silk text be 1.0 mm (JLCPCB standard) with the J1/J2 two-row names
expected: check_board OK at 1.0 mm text, DRC 0 after re-route, check_fab_rules JLCPCB all PASS
method: gen_pcb height 29 + text size 1.0 (+ GLYPH constants measured at 1.0 mm) + route + checks
fail: labels do not fit or routing fails
status: NOT_RUN (changes the user-approved 44x28 outline; run only if the JLCPCB high-precision option is unavailable or too costly)
